summary: All 49 claims trace to the page; no invented content. Most consequential: the red box (urgent attention, p82) is not encoded in the task, and the insect-bite rule is non-specific (grouped papule only, dropping blistered/darkening/scratch cues) with a wound-type SNOMED concept.
